ai_summary.headline: South Sudan MPCA is small (2.9% of prioritised needs) and slightly better funded than the plan, with a working CWG and JMMI.
ai_summary.narrative: The 2026 HNRP puts CVA at $110M, 11% of $1.04bn prioritised requirements, with MPCA only $30M (2.9%) for 475,600 people at $140 per household per month [s1]. Sectoral cash is $80M, so 73% of CVA sits with clusters. Live FTS (5 November) shows the MPC line at $33.5M and 46.9% funded ($15.7M), against 40.4% for the plan [s9]. Total CVA fell from about $197M in 2025 [s1]. The ISNA 2025 found 52% of surveyed people preferred cash to in-kind [s1]. The CWG meets monthly and runs a monthly JMMI [s5][s6], but market coverage fell from 85 to 67 markets while the MEB rose 58% in 2025 [s1]. Inference: MPCA is positioned for rapid response to new shocks but is unlikely to scale without funding, and weakening market monitoring puts transfer-value reviews at risk. CWG leadership records conflict between sources [s3][s4].
barriers: Plan only 40.4% funded; MPC line 46.9% funded ($15.7M of $33.5M) [s9]
Market monitoring coverage shrinking (85 to 67 markets) [s1]
MEB up 58% in 2025 pressures a fixed $140 transfer [s1]
No named social protection programme to link to [s1]
opportunities: 52% cash preference (ISNA 2025) supports expanding MPCA beyond 27% of CVA [s1]
MPCA built into rapid response for new shocks [s1]

total_funding_usd.note: All incoming funding to the plan, pledges excluded. Matches the FTS plan summary.

mpc_usd.note: FTS single-cluster view of the Multi-Purpose Cash cluster; shared-cluster view US$17.3M. Incoming flows, pledges excluded.

ctp_usd.note: All flows tagged 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)', inside or outside the MPC cluster.

sectoral_cva_usd.note: Flows whose FTS modality field is 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)' and whose destination cluster is not multi-purpose cash: 40 flows. The CTP tag is set by the reporting donor or agency and is not applied consistently, so this is a floor, not a measure of sectoral cash. Largest: Food Security US$3.4M, Protection US$2.3M, Refugee Response US$2.1M.

cva_usd.note: Union of the MPC cluster and the CTP tag. Widest defensible FTS cash figure; still a floor because untagged sectoral cash is invisible.

cva_pct_of_total.note: cva_usd as a share of total plan funding.

sectoral_cva_pct_of_total.note: sectoral_cva_usd as a share of total plan funding.

mpc_pct_of_total.note: MPC cluster funding as a share of total plan funding (single-cluster view).

fts_cva.caveat: FTS records funding, not transfers to people, and only to first-level recipients. Sectoral cash depends on a modality tag that reporters apply unevenly.
